summary: 80/80 pass. Git diff confirms that only the 8 snow stairs changed since round 5; the change is the pixel art plus the probe and sheet. Snow stairs h1 (w2 and w3) now runs edge to edge with no rim. Rows 1-12 are a pale-blue far tread. Rows 13-15 are a 3-step shadow gradient (#b9c6d8, #93a3bb, #71819a) sitting at the foot of the hidden riser. Rows 16-29 are a white near tread that continues the terrace snow. Rows 30-31 are the lip. At 1x the piece reads as a single snow step down to the north. It no longer reads as a framed panel or lid, and the shadow is on the physically correct side. Snow stairs h2 to h4 have a darker 1 px crease (#93a3bb in place of #b7cde3/#93aecb) with a white nosing row beneath it, which gives clearer tread separation; they stay consistent with the forward snow stairs. The other 72 pieces are unchanged and still read correctly in the probes and the village scenes, with no gaps or misalignment. Top minors: (1) snow h1 has only one division and no shadow at the road junction, so its read is weak but valid; (2) the snow crease is still much lighter than the forward set's dark risers; (3) snow ramps are tan with no snow; (4) grass stairs h1 has a box-like frame, mitigated by the curb continuation; (5) grass h4 and the h3-h4 ramps show stripe density that edges toward a grate or steps.
